Low to the northwest of Scotland, moving to the Norwegian Sea.

##State of Sea##

Mostly slight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Mostly good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##

##State of Sea##

##Visibility##

Mostly good.
